result.summary:
Round 2, lens execution: 16 items (8 market, 8 owner_fit), each covered once; 14 agree, 2 disagree.
Disagreements:
- owner_fit / 02-sai / no_selling_self: 5 -> 4. Same yardstick as 01 (4 for relying on personal ties): 02's test pre-sells a ~10 000 ₸ pilot of a product that does not exist yet ('без кода') to shops that do not know the owner, and payment is checked 'только на месте', so the buyer is trusting the owner rather than a product. Each shop also needs manual onboarding (measurements of every item).
- owner_fit / 03-zhivoy-most / no_selling_self: 4 -> 3. The only payer the idea names is managers (sales to organisations), which the owner rules out. The nearest remaining path is AI training, which is listed under 'Продажа экспертизы'. Non-programmers setting up Claude Code hooks implies personal setup help, i.e. a service.
Interruptions: the agent was stopped twice by API session limits (HTTP 429). The first time was before anything was written. The second was after crossreview-execution.json had been written but before this handoff was completed. After the second one I re-read the file and confirmed it is complete and what I intended; nothing was changed.
Self-check: `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260926-01 --stage crossreviews` -> `E_JSON crossreview-owner_fit.json: file is missing or unreadable`, exit=1. That analyst is still working, so the run-level check waits for ORCH once all three files exist. The validator stopped on that file, so I also ran my own check of the §4.6 rules on crossreview-execution.json (scratchpad script, not the project validator). It checks: top-level fields, produced_by against the roster, 16/16 pairs each exactly once, their_score equal to round 1, stance and note, disagree shape, sources listed in run.json, quotes of at least 12 characters and verbatim after whitespace normalisation. Output: `items=16 expected=16 disagree=2` / `ERRORS: none`.
